arc_summary: This edit traces the ephemeral arc of childhood joy, beginning with intimate moments of quiet innocence that gradually build into exuberant play and celebration, then gently resolves into tender reflection. I've selected diverse clips to create emotional variety, matching the musical energy with appropriate pacing—longer holds for introspective moments, faster cuts for energetic peaks, and a final lingering shot to emphasize the preciousness of memory.

cuts.purpose: Establishing shot—children standing quietly in a decorated hallway, setting a warm, innocent tone
Calm interaction between adults and child—gentle moment of connection and peace
Children lying still, looking toward camera—quiet, reflective innocence as music builds
Group organizing into a circle—playful interaction with moderate energy, matching the building music
Child walking and turning with moderate energy—joyful movement as intensity increases
Steady swinging with clear facial expressions—playful, rhythmic interaction
Initial hug and movement—warm, joyful interaction building toward peak
Sustained rhythmic dancing—energetic movement matching the musical peak around 21s
Peak chaotic movement and laughter—fast-paced, high-energy cut for celebration
Peak clapping and singing—burst of celebratory energy at loudest musical moment
Peak action with boy falling—dynamic, playful movement as energy begins to resolve
Children taking a bow—graceful, reflective moment as music softens
Boy leaning on bed—quiet, intimate stillness emphasizing tender reflection
Methodical digging with reduced movement—calm, focused activity for resolution
Boy's face after game ends—lingering shot of quiet realization, ending on precious memory
